evals.name: range-from-latest-tag-save-to-file
evals.prompt: 가장 최근 릴리즈 태그부터 지금까지 개발한 내용을 QA한테 넘길 문서로 정리해줘. QA는 코드 못 읽으니까 뭐가 바뀌었고 뭘 테스트해야 하는지 알 수 있어야 해. docs/handoff/ 아래에 파일로 저장해줘.
evals.expected_output: A markdown file under docs/handoff/ with a filename containing no slashes or spaces. Follow the template with 전체 요약, 기존과 달라진 변경사항, QA 체크리스트, 회귀 주의 영역, 자동 검증 결과, 용어 설명, 개발자 확인 사항. Describe before and after behavior. Each QA item has 전제, numbered 재현 절차, and an observable 기대 결과, without priority labels. Omit deployment prerequisites and invisible maintenance lists. Explain existing behavior to recheck and observed automated results in product terms; never invent test results. Define only necessary terms in short, distinct sentences. Resolve the range from the newest reachable tag, and keep range and commit evidence in an end reference rather than repeating hashes in QA items.

evals.name: weekly-summary-asks-destination
evals.prompt: 이번 주에 머지된 커밋들 정리해서 기획팀이랑 QA가 같이 볼 수 있게 변경사항 요약 + 확인 체크리스트 뽑아줘
evals.expected_output: A brief product summary and before/after comparison, followed by reproducible checks using 전제, 재현 절차, 기대 결과. No default deployment section, internal maintenance list, or required/secondary labels. Resolve the time window from available date context and state the interpretation without silently substituting an unrelated release range. Separate observed automated results from remaining QA work. Because this is a document request with no destination, ask where to put it before writing externally. Keep unresolved questions with named owners.

evals.name: release-eve-answers-in-conversation
evals.prompt: 내일 릴리즈인데 QA가 뭘 봐야 할지 물어봐. 최근 태그 이후 변경점 중에 사용자가 실제로 체감하는 것만 뽑아서 알려줘.
evals.expected_output: Answer in the conversation without writing a file or asking for a destination. Scope to the newest reachable tag..HEAD and describe observable before/after changes and reproduction checks without assigning release gates. Omit invisible maintenance while retaining relevant negative-path security or integrity checks. Unknown behavior becomes a developer question with an owner rather than a guessed expected result. Report an empty range instead of inventing changes. Do not fabricate automated verification or deployment status.

evals.name: api-change-in-own-implementation-ticket
evals.prompt: 이번 보너스 문구 변경을 내 FE 티켓의 QA handoff에 업데이트해줘. 상위 에픽 말고 내 구현 티켓이야. API 스펙에는 구간형 여부와 보상 개당 금액, 수량이 추가됐고 기존 보상 종류와 통화도 이제 문구 생성에 사용해. 실제 서버 연동은 아직이고 샘플 응답으로 화면 테스트만 통과했어. QA가 API의 어떤 변경이 어느 화면에 쓰이는지 알 수 있게 해줘.
evals.expected_output: Read the implementation ticket title, assignee, and description before editing; do not substitute its parent epic. Preserve unrelated content and read back the saved description. Include API 변경사항 after 기존과 달라진 변경사항, with verified field names, plain meanings, and the consuming screen behavior. Distinguish added range flag, unit value, and quantity from existing reward type and currency now used by the consumer. Explain that unit value times quantity supplies the displayed reward amount. Link the known contract without inventing an endpoint or field name. State that backend integration remains unverified and sample-response tests do not prove deployment. Use 전제, 재현 절차, 기대 결과 without priority labels, internal maintenance lists, or a deployment prerequisites section.
